data.name: Asra
data.gender_notes: Asra is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'asr', meaning 'to overtake'. In the Islamic context, Asra represents the night, the dark, and the passing of time. It's a name associated with the serenity and peace that often comes with the night. The name Asra carries the meaning “Night, the dark” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Asra usually hope their child will grow to embody night, the dark and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In the Quran, Asra is mentioned in Surah Al-Fatiha, which is the first chapter and the most frequently recited chapter in Islam. It is a reminder to seek Allah's guidance in the night and day.
data.etymology: Asra belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Night, the dark.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asra total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: أسرة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث يعني الليل أو الستر
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أسرة هو اسم مؤنث عربي مشتق من الجذر اللغوي س-ر-ى، والذي يعني الليل أو الستر. ورد هذا الاسم في القرآن الكريم في سورة الفرقان الآية 53، حيث يقول تعالى: 'وَهُوَ الَذِي يَبُثُّ الرِياحَ مُبَشِّرَاتٍ وَمُعَذِّبَاتٍ وَيَجْعَلُ السَّحَابَ ثُمَّ يَأْتِي بِالسَّحَابِ الْمُحَمَّلِ ثُمَّ يُمِرُّهُ عَلَى بَلَدٍ مُّسَوَّمٍ وَيُسِقُهُ مَآثِرَ قَطِرِهِ وَيَجْعَلُ السَّمَاءَ كَالْفُخَّةِ الْمَرْفُوعَةِ وَيَجْعَلُ الظُّلَمَ وَالنُّورَ ثُمَّ بَيَّنَ آيَاتِهِ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ'. وقد وردت كلمة أسري في القرآن الكريم بمعنى الليل.

in_urdu.name: آسرا
in_urdu.long_meaning: آسرا اردو میں ایک خوبصورت اور معقول نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے رات یا پناہ۔ یہ نام عربی جڑ س-ر-ى سے نکلا ہے جو کہ قرآن کریم میں بھی موجود ہے۔ اس نام کا انتخاب کرنے سے آپ کے بچے کی شخصیت پر رات کی طرح سحر انگیز اور دلکش اثر پڑ سکتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: आसरा
in_hindi.long_meaning: आसरा एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है रात या आश्रय। यह नाम अरबी मूल स-र-ى से निकला है, जो कुरआन में भी पाया जाता है। इस नाम का चयन करने से आपके बच्चे की व्यक्तित्व पर रात की तरह जादुई और आकर्षक प्रभाव पड़ सकता है।

in_pashto.name: آساره
in_pashto.long_meaning: آساره په پښتو کې یو ښکلی او معنی لرونکی نوم دی چې د عربی ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی. د دې مطلب دی شپه یا پناه. دا نوم د عربی ریښې س-ر-ى څخه راغلی دی، کوم چې په قران کریم کې هم شتون لري. د دې نوم انتخاب کول ممکن ستاسو د ماشوم په شخصیت باندې د شپې په څیر جادویی او زړه راښکونکي اغیزه ولري.

in_english.name: Asra
in_english.long_meaning: The name Asra is of Arabic origin, derived from the root 's-r-y', which means 'to travel at night' or 'shelter'. In Islamic tradition, Asra is associated with the night and is mentioned in the Quran. The name symbolizes protection, shelter, and the mystical qualities of the night. It is often chosen for its spiritual significance and beautiful connotations.

data.cultural_impact: The term "Asra" holds a significant cultural impact in Islamic traditions. In the Islamic calendar, the night of Asra is considered as one of the nights of renowned importance. According to Islamic beliefs, during this night, Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) performed an extensive night prayer ('Itikaf' or 'Solah') in the mosque, seeking forgiveness and nearness to Allah SWT. This act Inspired many Muslims to emulate the habit of the Prophet (PBUH) throughout the year, leading to numerous acts of worship and piety.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Asra" carries a profound spiritual significance in Islam. It symbolizes the idea of passing time, which is only an opportunity to seek Allah's pleasure and come closer to Him. The name encourages reflection and the practice of conscious living, especially during the night hours. This helps Muslims to connect with their faith more deeply, as they seek to establish a stronger bond with Allah amidst the tranquility and serenity of the night..

historical_references.context: Asra was a member of the Ansar, the early converts to Islam in Medina. She was known for her generosity and hospitality to the Prophet and his companions.
